description.en: Granny Maggie has sung in the choir for sixty years and never misses a concert: the orchestra in Kendal, the folk night at the inn, the rehearsals and the applause, a play at the Theatre by the Lake, and the exhibition at the gallery in Grasmere.
description.sl: Babica Maggie poje v zboru že šestdeset let in ne zamudi nobenega koncerta: orkester v Kendalu, ljudski večer v gostilni, vaje in aplavz, predstava v gledališču ob jezeru in razstava v galeriji v Grasmeru.
description.it: Nonna Maggie canta nel coro da sessant'anni e non perde un concerto: l'orchestra a Kendal, la serata folk alla locanda, le prove e gli applausi, uno spettacolo al Theatre by the Lake e la mostra alla galleria di Grasmere.
description.de: Oma Maggie singt seit sechzig Jahren im Chor und verpasst kein Konzert: das Orchester in Kendal, den Folkabend im Gasthaus, die Proben und den Applaus, ein Stück im Theatre by the Lake und die Ausstellung in der Galerie in Grasmere.

words.example_en: The choir gives a concert in the church every Christmas.
words.example_sl: Zbor vsak božič priredi koncert v cerkvi.
words.example_it: Il coro fa un concerto in chiesa ogni Natale.
words.example_de: Der Chor gibt jedes Weihnachten ein Konzert in der Kirche.

words.example_en: Do you play an instrument? We need a drummer.
words.example_sl: Igraš kakšno glasbilo? Potrebujemo bobnarja.
words.example_it: Suoni uno strumento? Ci serve un batterista.
words.example_de: Spielst du ein Instrument? Wir brauchen einen Schlagzeuger.

words.example_en: The orchestra played music by Elgar in the old church.
words.example_sl: Orkester je v stari cerkvi igral Elgarjevo glasbo.
words.example_it: L'orchestra ha suonato musica di Elgar nella vecchia chiesa.
words.example_de: Das Orchester spielte in der alten Kirche Musik von Elgar.

words.example_en: The children performed a play about the Bowder Stone.
words.example_sl: Otroci so nastopili z igro o skali Bowder Stone.
words.example_it: I bambini si sono esibiti in una recita sul Bowder Stone.
words.example_de: Die Kinder sind mit einem Stück über den Bowder Stone aufgetreten.

words.example_en: The last performance is on Saturday night.
words.example_sl: Zadnja predstava je v soboto zvečer.
words.example_it: L'ultimo spettacolo è sabato sera.
words.example_de: Die letzte Aufführung ist am Samstagabend.

words.example_en: The audience stood up and clapped for five minutes.
words.example_sl: Občinstvo je vstalo in ploskalo pet minut.
words.example_it: Gli spettatori si sono alzati e hanno applaudito per cinque minuti.
words.example_de: Das Publikum stand auf und klatschte fünf Minuten lang.

words.example_en: Poppy was so nervous that she nearly fell off the stage.
words.example_sl: Poppy je bila tako živčna, da je skoraj padla z odra.
words.example_it: Poppy era così nervosa che per poco non cadeva dal palcoscenico.
words.example_de: Poppy war so nervös, dass sie fast von der Bühne gefallen wäre.

words.example_en: There's an exhibition of old photos of the dale at the library.
words.example_sl: V knjižnici je razstava starih fotografij doline.
words.example_it: In biblioteca c'è una mostra di vecchie foto della valle.
words.example_de: In der Bibliothek gibt es eine Ausstellung alter Fotos vom Tal.

words.example_en: The gallery in Grasmere sells paintings of the fells.
words.example_sl: Galerija v Grasmeru prodaja slike hribov.
words.example_it: La galleria di Grasmere vende quadri dei monti.
words.example_de: Die Galerie in Grasmere verkauft Bilder von den Bergen.

words.example_en: A sculpture of a sheep stands outside the auction mart.
words.example_sl: Pred živinskim sejmiščem stoji kip ovce.
words.example_it: Davanti al mercato del bestiame c'è una scultura di una pecora.
words.example_de: Vor dem Viehmarkt steht eine Skulptur eines Schafs.

words.example_en: Many artists came to the Lakes for the light.
words.example_sl: Mnogo umetnikov je prišlo na jezera zaradi svetlobe.
words.example_it: Molti artisti sono venuti ai Laghi per la luce.
words.example_de: Viele Künstler kamen wegen des Lichts in die Lakes.

words.example_en: At the craft fair you can buy baskets, pottery and wool.
words.example_sl: Na sejmu domače obrti lahko kupiš košare, lončevino in volno.
words.example_it: Alla fiera dell'artigianato si comprano cesti, ceramiche e lana.
words.example_de: Auf dem Kunsthandwerksmarkt kann man Körbe, Töpferwaren und Wolle kaufen.

words.example_en: Harry has a talent for drawing animals.
words.example_sl: Harry ima talent za risanje živali.
words.example_it: Harry ha talento nel disegnare animali.
words.example_de: Harry hat Talent im Tierezeichnen.

words.example_en: The choir has a rehearsal every Tuesday in the village hall.
words.example_sl: Zbor ima vsak torek skušnjo v vaškem domu.
words.example_it: Il coro ha le prove ogni martedì nella sala del paese.
words.example_de: Der Chor hat jeden Dienstag Probe im Gemeindesaal.

words.example_en: Wilf's story got the loudest applause of the evening.
words.example_sl: Wilfova zgodba je dobila najglasnejši aplavz večera.
words.example_it: La storia di Wilf ha avuto gli applausi più forti della serata.
words.example_de: Wilfs Geschichte bekam den lautesten Applaus des Abends.
words.note: Applause is uncountable: a round of applause.
words.note_sl: Applause je neštevno: a round of applause.
words.note_it: Applause non si conta: a round of applause.
words.note_de: Applause ist unzählbar: a round of applause.

words.example_en: Sam knows all the lyrics of the old Cumbrian songs.
words.example_sl: Sam pozna vsa besedila starih kumbrijskih pesmi.
words.example_it: Sam conosce tutti i testi delle vecchie canzoni della Cumbria.
words.example_de: Sam kennt alle Liedtexte der alten Lieder aus Cumbria.

words.example_en: The Theatre by the Lake in Keswick has plays all year round.
words.example_sl: Gledališče ob jezeru v Keswicku ima predstave vse leto.
words.example_it: Il Theatre by the Lake di Keswick ha spettacoli tutto l'anno.
words.example_de: Das Theatre by the Lake in Keswick spielt das ganze Jahr.

words.example_en: In the interval everyone queued for ice cream.
words.example_sl: Med gledališkim odmorom so vsi stali v vrsti za sladoled.
words.example_it: Durante l'intervallo tutti facevano la coda per il gelato.
words.example_de: In der Theaterpause standen alle für Eis an.

words.example_en: On Fridays there's folk music by the fire at the inn.
words.example_sl: Ob petkih je v gostilni ob ognju ljudska glasba.
words.example_it: Il venerdì alla locanda c'è musica folk vicino al fuoco.
words.example_de: Freitags gibt es im Gasthaus am Feuer Volksmusik.

words.example_en: The composer wrote a piece about the sound of the becks.
words.example_sl: Skladatelj je napisal skladbo o zvoku potokov.
words.example_it: Il compositore ha scritto un brano sul suono dei ruscelli.
words.example_de: Der Komponist schrieb ein Stück über das Rauschen der Bäche.

words.example_en: Three musicians from Ireland played at the barn dance.
words.example_sl: Na plesu na skednju so igrali trije glasbeniki z Irske.
words.example_it: Al ballo nel fienile hanno suonato tre musicisti irlandesi.
words.example_de: Beim Scheunentanz spielten drei Musiker aus Irland.

words.example_en: Sam's band has a gig at a pub in Penrith on Saturday.
words.example_sl: Samova skupina ima v soboto nastop v gostilni v Penrithu.
words.example_it: La band di Sam ha un concertino in un pub di Penrith sabato.
words.example_de: Sams Band hat am Samstag einen Auftritt in einem Pub in Penrith.
words.note: Gig is informal: a small concert, often in a pub.
words.note_sl: Gig je pogovorno: manjši koncert, pogosto v gostilni.
words.note_it: Gig è informale: un piccolo concerto, spesso in un pub.
words.note_de: Gig ist umgangssprachlich: ein kleiner Auftritt, oft im Pub.

words.example_en: Clap along to the rhythm!
words.example_sl: Ploskaj v ritmu!
words.example_it: Batti le mani a ritmo!
words.example_de: Klatsch im Rhythmus mit!
words.note: Rhythm has no vowel after the y: r-h-y-t-h-m.
words.note_sl: Rhythm nima samoglasnika za y: r-h-y-t-h-m.
words.note_it: Rhythm non ha vocali dopo la y: r-h-y-t-h-m.
words.note_de: Rhythm hat nach dem y keinen Vokal: r-h-y-t-h-m.

words.example_en: The conductor raised her hands, and the orchestra began.
words.example_sl: Dirigentka je dvignila roke in orkester je začel.
words.example_it: La direttrice d'orchestra ha alzato le mani e l'orchestra ha cominciato.
words.example_de: Die Dirigentin hob die Hände, und das Orchester begann.
words.note: A conductor is also the person who checks tickets on a train or bus.
words.note_it: Il conductor è anche il controllore sul treno o sull'autobus.
words.note_de: Ein conductor ist auch der Schaffner.
